title: Cohort-correlation watchdog and staged human-in-loop rollback
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a correlation-driven watchdog that ties eval prompt-set regressions to production cohort signals (engagement, error-rate, latency) and automates staged quarantine and rollback with a mandatory human-in-loop approval step. The watchdog should operate across canary and A/B cohorts as well as shadow traffic. It will surface correlated anomalies, quantify confidence, and only trigger automated staged rollback when hysteresis and multi-signal confirmation are met; otherwise it should quarantine the cohort and require operator review.
background: Current eval-based gates flag regressions using golden prompt sets, but we see noisy signals that don't always correspond to user-visible regressions. Teams have asked for a system that correlates eval scorecard deltas with production cohort metrics (e.g., per-cohort CTR, avg latency, request error-rate) so we can avoid false positives and reduce human toil. This ticket proposes a watchdog that (1) computes cross-correlation between eval deltas and runtime metrics, (2) uses per-cohort baselines, (3) applies hysteresis to prevent flip-flopping, and (4) inserts a human approval step before full rollback for high-confidence but high-impact regressions.
goals: Correlate eval scorecard regressions with at least three production signals at cohort level
Provide a quantitative confidence score for each regression event
Automatically quarantine affected cohorts and limit traffic while awaiting human review
Allow automated rollback only when multi-signal thresholds and hysteresis conditions are met
Integrate with Console alerts and existing rollout conductor for visibility
success_metrics: Reduce false-positive automated rollbacks by >= 60% compared to eval-only gating
Mean time to detection (MTTD) for real regressions remains <= 2 minutes
Operators approve or dismiss quarantine events within 30 minutes for 80% of cases
No production user-visible incidents caused by missed regressions in pilot cohorts over 3 months
design_summary: Watchdog listens to eval score delta stream (golden sets) and production metrics stream per cohort. For each cohort we compute rolling z-scores against baseline windows and then estimate cross-correlation and Granger-causality proxies to increase confidence that the eval regression is predictive of production impact. Decision logic: if confidence < low_threshold -> create ticket/alert only; if low_threshold <= confidence < auto_quarantine_threshold -> quarantine cohort (route traffic to baseline model variant or reduce traffic) and notify; if confidence >= auto_rollback_threshold and hysteresis (persisted for N minutes and corroborated by >=2 signals) then initiate staged rollback with automated canary to fallback model after human notification. Human-in-loop API endpoint required to either approve immediate rollback or dismiss and unquarantine after investigations.
implementation_tasks: Add per-cohort baseline aggregation to metrics pipeline (latency, 5xx rate, engagement)
Ingest eval score deltas tagged by cohort and map to runtime traffic segments
Implement correlation/confidence estimator (z-scores + signal agreement heuristic)
Create quarantine action that reduces cohort weight and routes to stable model variant
Integrate human-in-loop approval flow into Console (confirm/dismiss) and store audit log
Wire alerts into Slack + Console timeline + PagerDuty for high-severity events
End-to-end tests with synthetic regressions and A/B canary harness
acceptance_criteria: System can detect synthetic eval regression and correlate with a synthetic rise in cohort error-rate in staging
Quarantine action successfully reduces live traffic weight for affected cohort without dropping requests
Console shows confidence score, correlated signals, and required human-approval button
Automated rollback only executes when configured thresholds and hysteresis are satisfied and an audit entry is created
Runbook updated and on-call run through completed with SREs and PMs
rollout_plan: Start with a staging pilot for internal beta customers: enable watchdog for 5 internal teams on non-critical models for two weeks; evaluate false positive and false negative rates. Stage to canary cohorts (1%, 10%, 50%) for two customers with explicit opt-in. After 6 weeks of stable telemetry and at most one manual intervention per team, enable broader Default opt-in with opt-out controls. Full product release gated on runbook sign-off and post-pilot postmortem.
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert - low_confidence_quarantine: notifies team in Slack and creates Linear ticket
Alert - high_confidence_auto_rollback: triggers PagerDuty and posts to Console timeline
Dashboard - cohort-correlation-overview: per-cohort confidence score, recent correlated signals
SLOs - false_rollback_rate and quarantine_response_time tracked weekly
